name: extraction-report
description: What each drawpoint actually pulled, period by period, broken down by ore grade and by origin and destination level.

layout.header: a two-line preamble (`CurPrd`, `CurPrdName`, `DaysSolved` and their values) followed by the table header on line 3

columns.name: PrdName
columns.description: Period name, from the draw-schedule header.

columns.name: CumMass
columns.description: Cumulative mass extracted at this drawpoint.

columns.name: RingMass
columns.description: Mass extracted from the SLC ring.

columns.name: <grade>Mass
columns.description: One column per ore grade of the block model, the mass-weighted grade contribution.

example: DPName	Period	PrdName	CumMass	RingMass	PeriodMass	UCSMass	...	1Orig	...	1Dest	...
notes: The grade columns are named after the extra columns of the block-model file, with `Mass` appended.
The origin/destination columns are the SLC level tracking that the `l<level>` drawpoint naming convention exists for.
official_documentation: Read back from the file the command writes; the command page documents no columns.
